about.heading: A good congress moves science and people forward
paragraphs: New insights, shared knowledge and encounters that lead to new ideas and collaborations.
JCC takes the organisation off your hands. From the programme and speakers to the venue, registration and budget. With direct communication, personal attention and an eye for every detail.
This creates room for what really matters: the content and the people.

annick.heading: Bringing people
paragraphs: I’m Annick Goijarts, owner of JCC Congress Consultancy & Events. I’ve been working in the congress and events industry for over twenty years.

For many years, I worked at the Amsterdam Convention Bureau, where I gained experience with a wide range of national and international congresses. My work at KLM also took me to special places around the world.
The common thread? Bringing people together, organising and making sure everything runs smoothly.
Together with a network of experienced professionals and trusted partners, I organise medical and scientific congresses in the Netherlands and abroad.
Personally involved, direct communication and always with an eye for the content.

band.intro: No two congresses are the same. Luckily.
band.text:
From a small symposium to a large international scientific congress, every event calls for its own approach.

JCC works alongside you, responds quickly and brings the right people and resources together. With personal attention, an eye for detail and an approach that fits your organisation.

social.title: Not on the agenda,
social.text:
The most valuable encounters don’t always take place in the congress hall. A well-designed social programme creates space for conversations, connection and relaxation.

From a special congress dinner to relaxed drinks or an evening party, we create memorable moments beyond the scientific programme.
